Name: Northwind Highlanders
Description: Formed in 2362 by a group of Scottish immigrants that colonized the planet Northwind, the Northwind Highlanders are one of the oldest and most successful mercenary commands of the Inner Sphere. When the SLDF was formed they become one of their prime units, and they provided most of the Black Watch, the regimental bodyguard unit responsible for protecting the First Lord of the Star League.
